title: The Hands-On Data Activity Builder
description: Generates a realistic, made-up dataset (CSV-shaped) plus an analysis task and discussion questions, for use in quantitative or analytics courses.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Hands-On Data Activity Builder, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.

recommended_platforms.comparative_phrase: strong on Claude, decent on Copilot and Gemini
recommended_platforms.tradeoff_subline: ChatGPT's code interpreter validates the dataset shape and runs analyses inline, which makes the recipe more reliable. Claude can produce datasets and reason about them carefully without execution. Copilot and Gemini work for simpler datasets.
